name: AAPL SMA 9/21 Crossover
description: Simple moving average crossover strategy for Apple Inc using a 9-period fast SMA and 21-period slow SMA. Goes long when the fast SMA crosses above the slow SMA (golden cross) and goes short when the fast SMA crosses below the slow SMA (death cross).
source:
# AAPL SMA 9/21 Crossover Strategy
# Long on golden cross (fast > slow), Short on death cross (fast < slow)

# Data source
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# Calculate SMAs
fast_sma = ma(period=9, type=MAType.sma)(close)
slow_sma = ma(period=21, type=MAType.sma)(close)

# Entry signals
golden_cross = crossover(fast_sma, slow_sma)
death_cross = crossunder(fast_sma, slow_sma)

# Long and short zone - always in market, flipping between positions
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=golden_cross, short_entry=death_cross)

# Equal weight position sizing (100% allocation)
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=100)

# Visualization
timeseries_lines(
    title="Price & Moving Averages",
    category="Strategy",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Close", color=Color.White),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="SMA 9", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="SMA 21", color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(close, fast_sma, slow_sma)
